name: exocortex_epistemic_milestone
description: Crystallized phase-space topology capturing theoretical foundations, operational closure, and empirical validation of the Exocortex human-machine symbiosis.

nodes.label: Licklider Symbiosis & Agency Preservation
nodes.content: The operator remains the sovereign teleological anchor. AI acts as a high-fidelity cognitive amplifier and phase-space computer, never as an unconstrained autonomous black box.

nodes.label: Kolmogorov Minimality (<350 Token Attractor)
nodes.content: Knowledge and constraints must be maximally compressed into dense mathematical invariants rather than sprawling prompt text.

nodes.label: Reflexive Autopoiesis (Self-Hardening)
nodes.content: The system applies its own architectural and epistemic primitives to design, verify, and harden its own code base and documentation.

nodes.label: Prohibition of Unconstrained Delegation
nodes.content: Never delegate sovereign design choices or ethical vetoes to stochastic autonomous loops. Explicit human checkpoints are non-negotiable.

nodes.label: Popperian Anti-Sycophancy
nodes.content: Refuse opportunistic agreement. Intervene immediately on architectural flaws, logic violations, and invariant breaches.

nodes.label: Via Negativa (Constraint Primacy)
nodes.content: System stability is achieved primarily by defining what is strictly prohibited (boundaries) rather than prescribing all possible actions.

nodes.label: Topological Rehydration
nodes.content: Compile active graph states into token-dense attractor prompts via vector-resonance and boundary projection before every inference turn.

nodes.label: Operational Closure & Snapshot Crystallization
nodes.content: Persist verified session trajectories as immutable JSON/Canvas snapshots in topologies/snapshots/ without mutating base topologies.

nodes.label: Empirical Grounding: Showcase 07
nodes.content: Substrate-independent zero-shot sycophancy suppression verified on Mistral Large 3 with a-priori evaluation protocol on 2026-08-22.

nodes.label: Theoretical Foundation: docs/THEORY.md
nodes.content: Formal synthesis of Popperian demarcation, Heinz von Foerster's second-order cybernetics, and Kolmogorov complexity anchored in git.

nodes.label: Operational CLI Interface: chat_exocortex.py
nodes.content: Dual-mode interactive runner (Local/Remote MCP) with real-time Obsidian .canvas sync and zero-drift command parsing.
